metadata.name: fmt2-sec-rdma-positive-control
metadata.description: Use kvm-sfo200-sec-9923 as the non-destructive positive-control R630 for ConnectX-4/RoCEv2 admission while pri remains gated on physical ConnectX replacement.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible root containing host E2ET definitions and playbooks.

variables.name: sec_host
variables.description: FMT2 R630 host with working X710 and ConnectX-4 discovery paths.

variables.name: ter_host
variables.description: FMT2 R630 peer used for later pairwise RDMA smoke because it also has active ConnectX-4 links.

variables.name: arista_host
variables.description: Arista 7060 switch with sec ConnectX-facing ports Et7/1 and Et7/3.

variables.name: e2et_manifest
variables.description: Positive-control admission manifest that remains blocked until vendor driver and pairwise RDMA gates pass.

stages.summary: Capture sec host inventory without changing disk, network, driver, or service state.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Capture on sec: hostname; uname -a; lspci -Dnn; ip -br link; ip -br addr; ethtool -i eno1 eno2 eno3 eno4 enp130s0f0np0 enp130s0f1np1; ethtool link speed checks; rdma link show; lsmod mlx5/i40e/rdma modules; /sys/class/net/*/device/sriov_totalvfs and sriov_numvfs. Do not mutate sec storage, pri, ter, or X12AGAIN.'

stages.summary: Capture Arista Et7/1 and Et7/3 status, LLDP, counters, and Po713 config as the known-good switch-side comparison for pri.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Capture on Arista: show interfaces Ethernet7/1 status; show interfaces Ethernet7/3 status; show lldp neighbors Ethernet7/1 detail; show lldp neighbors Ethernet7/3 detail; show interfaces Ethernet7/1 counters errors; show interfaces Ethernet7/3 counters errors; show running-config interfaces Ethernet7/1 Ethernet7/3 Port-Channel713.'

stages.summary: Run the NVIDIA DOCA/OFED role in preflight mode and keep the same vendor driver family used by ConnectX-4 and BlueField-2 behind one gate.
Close the current userspace tooling gap before pairwise testing; do not treat in-kernel mlx5 alone as production admission.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Required before pairwise smoke: ofed_info -s; ibv_devinfo; rping or ibv_rc_pingpong; ib_write_bw or ib_send_bw; rdma resource show. Install through the selected vendor OFED/DOCA or Gentoo stage4 profile, not ad-hoc unmanaged packages.'

stages.summary: Run sec to ter pairwise RDMA smoke only after both endpoints have vendor driver reporting and userspace RDMA tools.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Deferred gate: run pairwise RDMA smoke between sec and ter over the independent 50G ConnectX paths, then test one-path-failure behavior before any LACP, OVS switchdev, or production storage promotion.'

stages.summary: Render the sec RDMA E2ET conformance report; blocked is expected until vendor driver and pairwise gates are updated with passing evidence.
